title: nf-WGS-QC pipeline common parameters
description: Whole genome sequencing quality control pipeline.

output_options.title: Output options
output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

project_id.description: A project ID string used in reports and manifests

reference_files.title: Reference files
reference_files.description: Input reference files shared by all workflows

genome_fasta.description: Path to reference genome FASTA file. A fasta index (.fai) must be present in the same location

regions_bed.description: Path to a BED file containing regions of interest. Additional stats over these regions will be computed for variants and coverage.

advanced_configuration_parameters.title: Advanced configuration parameters
advanced_configuration_parameters.description: Advanced parameters to control Nextflow pipeline execution

help.description: Show the help message for the pipeline.
help.help_text: If set to `true`, the pipeline will print a help message with the command to run it and the available parameters.

gpu_container_options.description: Special configuration parameters to pass to the container to use GPU resources

publish_dir_mode.description: Mode used when publishing files to output folder

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use colors in validation and other log messages
